name: r05-ext-v1
note: Extra actor ramps for the R05 (Lot) enemies, light to dark, added on top of the unchanged art 03 master palette (byte copy in src/palette_v03.json). Ramp names must not collide with the base. Reused base ramps: gold (E1 ornaments), bone (E1 teeth, E2 arm and hand), tongue (E1), eye (E1), white (E2 eyes), outline.

why.glut: E1 body: a wine-maroon sack, away from the green grass and the tan path, so the gold reads as decoration on a dark body
why.linger: E2 robe: a cold grey-teal, apart from the warm E1 and E3 and greyer than the grass; the pale bony arm is the brightest part
why.ash: E3 smoke and body: warm ash grey, lighter than the grass so the fastest enemy is the easiest to spot
why.cinder: E3 ember eyes and chest cracks: the small hot accent; never a large area
